lcc_original: 上帝就給它們祝福說：『要繁殖增多，充滿海中的水；飛鳥也要增多在地上。』
notes: 神(UNV)→上帝(LCC): systematic UNV/LCC difference for H430 (אֱלֹהִים)
就賜福給(UNV)→就給祝福(LCC): LCC reorders the verbal construction; H1288+TH8762 attach to 祝福 which carries the bless semantics
{<WAH0853>}(accusative marker H853) kept implicit after 它們: 它們 translates the pronoun 'them' (=UNV 這一切) but H853 itself is a grammatical direct-object particle with no explicit LCC word
滋生(UNV)→繁殖(LCC) for H6509 (פָּרָה, be fruitful); 繁多/多生(UNV)→增多(LCC) for H7235 (רָבָה, multiply) — both are synonym substitutions with clear one-to-one correspondence
雀鳥(UNV)→飛鳥(LCC) for H5775 (עוֹף, flying creature/bird): different Chinese synonyms, same referent
